name: Dacorum Local Plan Revised Strategy for Growth

housing-numbers.notes: This is a HRA document focusing on environmental assessment rather than detailed housing numbers. Only windfall figure of 305 dwellings for countryside areas was clearly identified. Settlement-specific numbers mentioned include: Hemel Hempstead 11,742 homes, Berkhamsted 1,264 homes, Tring 522 homes, Kings Langley 68 homes, Bovingdon 230 homes, Markyate 53 homes, plus 466 homes in countryside areas.
